title: 5.1.7 Lab: Drop one sprite, change its color
description: Practice from 2.1.3b: create a canvas, drop a single sprite at the centre, and set its color. Three steps, no movement yet.

steps.title: Make a canvas
steps.instructions: Inside `setup()`, call `new Canvas(...)` with a width and height of your choice (anything from 300 to 600 works).
hints: Open the moSHion docs drawer on the right and find the Canvas section.

steps.title: Create one sprite at the centre
steps.instructions: Still inside `setup()`, call `new Sprite(x, y, w, h)` to place a sprite roughly in the middle of your canvas.
hints: Check the Sprite section of the moSHion docs drawer for what the four arguments mean.

steps.title: Set the sprite's color
steps.instructions: Store the sprite in a variable, then assign a CSS color string to its `.color` property: try `'tomato'`, `'deepskyblue'`, or any color you like.
hints: Look up sprite properties in the moSHion docs drawer.

requirements.title: Create a canvas
requirements.description: Call new Canvas(...) inside setup() to open a drawing area.

requirements.title: Create a sprite
requirements.description: Call new Sprite(...) inside setup() to put a rectangle on the canvas.

requirements.title: Set the sprite's color
requirements.description: Assign a color string to the sprite's .color property.
